description: Architectural catalogue for campus.json footprints used by the generated context (lib/campus/context). Archetypes encode real UT/Austin building families; every building records basis: known (identity and architecture known), estimate (named, style guessed) or district-default (unnamed; assigned from district, footprint area and height). Colours/modules are reference-guided estimates, not measurements. Measured massing is applied at runtime from public/data/derived/roofs-lidar.json (2017 USGS 3DEP LiDAR) when present.

lidar.source: USGS 3DEP Lidar Point Cloud TX_Central_B1_2017 (StratMap 2017 50cm), tiles 3097433a3/a4/c1/c2; public domain

cret-core.label: Cret/Greene-era Spanish-Mediterranean core
cret-core.reference: UT 1930s Cret master plan idiom: cream limestone ground storey and trim, buff brick upper walls, red clay barrel-tile hipped roofs on carved/bracketed eaves (Garrison, Painter, Gearing, Biology Labs).

cret-residence.label: Core-idiom residence hall
cret-residence.reference: Women's/men's dorms of 1927-1958 (Littlefield, Andrews, Carothers, Roberts, Prather, Moore-Hill, Kinsolving) and the 2000s San Jacinto/Duren halls: buff brick, limestone trim, red tile hipped roofs.

master-plan.label: 1999 master-plan campus building
master-plan.reference: Post-1999 Pelli master plan guidance: buff brick with limestone base and bands, larger punched windows with metal sunshades, flat roofs behind parapets (EER, Rowling, HDB-era campus buildings).

master-plan-tile.label: 1999 master-plan building with tile roof
master-plan-tile.reference: Master-plan buildings that reuse the red tile roof (AT&T Center, Blanton, Seay): buff brick, limestone, tile hipped roofs without heavy brackets.

modernist-lab.label: 1960s-80s brick/precast teaching and lab building
modernist-lab.reference: Late-modern UT labs and classroom blocks (Burdine, CPE, ETC, Sanchez, PMA/former RLM): tan brick piers or spandrels with precast bands and horizontal window strips, flat roofs with mechanical penthouses.

brutalist-precast.label: 1970s precast/concrete
brutalist-precast.reference: 1970s precast concrete buildings (Communication B, Harry Ransom Center, Performing Arts Center): deep-set narrow windows in heavy precast frames.

modernist-dorm.label: Late-modern high-rise residence
modernist-dorm.reference: Jester Center / Dobie-era residence towers: buff brick and precast, repetitive small dorm windows, flat roofs.

stone-civic.label: Limestone civic/museum building
stone-civic.reference: Art-Deco/stripped classical limestone buildings (Texas Memorial Museum, Hogg Auditorium) and limestone state buildings of the Capitol complex.

monolith-stone.label: Travertine monolith
monolith-stone.reference: LBJ Library and Sid Richardson Hall (Skidmore Owings & Merrill, 1971): near-windowless travertine walls with glazed ground storey.

garage.label: Parking garage
garage.reference: UT garages (Speedway, San Jacinto, Brazos, Trinity, 27th St): precast spandrel bands with open, unglazed decks.

athletic.label: Athletics/recreation hall
athletic.reference: Stadium/field support buildings, natatorium and training halls: large precast/brick volumes with sparse high glazing.

arena.label: Arena (metal and glass)
arena.reference: Moody Center: metal-clad arena bowl over a glazed concourse.

utility.label: Service / facilities building
utility.reference: Storehouses, plant and facilities buildings: painted CMU/precast with few windows.

medical-modern.label: Dell Medical District building
medical-modern.reference: Dell Medical School buildings (Health Discovery/Learning, 2017): limestone-like panels with tall glazing and metal fins.

office-tower.label: Downtown/West-downtown office or condo tower
office-tower.reference: Generic Austin downtown tower envelope: precast/metal spandrels with continuous glazing.

state-office.label: Capitol-complex state office building
state-office.reference: Mid-century state office buildings around the Capitol (Sam Houston, LBJ, Travis buildings): cream limestone or granite-faced grids of punched windows, flat roofs; pink-granite base tone nods to the Capitol's sunset red granite.

wc-tower.label: West Campus high-rise student housing
wc-tower.reference: Post-2004 University Neighborhood Overlay towers: stucco and fibre-cement panel upper storeys over a brick/masonry base, retail at Guadalupe/24th frontages.

wc-midrise.label: West/North Campus mid-rise apartments
wc-midrise.reference: 4-8 storey student apartments: stucco over brick base, punched windows, flat roofs.

apartment-lowrise.label: 1960s-80s low-rise apartments
apartment-lowrise.reference: Two/three-storey brick and stucco garden apartments typical of North University and West Campus side streets.

house.label: Bungalow / small house
house.reference: Hyde Park / North University / Judges Hill bungalows and four-squares: painted lap siding on a pier-and-beam limestone skirt, double-hung windows, hipped or gabled composition-shingle roofs.

historic-19c.label: 19th-century masonry building
historic-19c.reference: Pre-1900 stone/brick buildings (Littlefield Home, Arno Nowotny): tall narrow windows, steep metal or slate hipped roofs.

small-commercial.label: Small commercial / retail
small-commercial.reference: One/two-storey retail and offices (Guadalupe "Drag", Lavaca, MLK): brick or stucco with storefront glazing and a parapet.
